value.heading: An engineering-to-medicine path
value.text: Khamsi’s practice biography traces his first degree to electrical engineering at UCLA, followed by a change to medicine that he attributes in part to his grandmother’s influence. It says he served as administrative chief resident during orthopedic residency and received a Resident Teaching Award from peers. The biography also says he later studied part time for a healthcare MBA to better understand the non-medical side of healthcare and advocate for patients. His practice reports that he traveled to Guadalajara multiple times to perform complex reconstructive surgeries for children with severe spinal deformities; it does not give dates or patient outcomes.

value.heading: Planning a visit
value.text: Riverside Community Hospital’s profile lists Haider Spine Center at 6276 River Crest Dr., Suite A, Riverside, and (951) 413-0200. It advises self-pay patients to call. The profile does not show appointment availability or name specific insurance plans, so confirm scheduling and plan participation with the practice.
